note: The client's function every coded string is handed to for decoding into text. The pattern and the resolver are Py4GW Reforged Native's, unchanged (offsets/ui.json at 82e4746: validate_async_decode, validate_async_decode_str_func), where the function is ValidateAsyncDecodeStr, void __cdecl (const wchar_t* coded, DecodeStr_Callback callback, void* param). Kryta.dll stands in front of it so that a map whose record states a name or a description of its own (client_row.name, client_row.description) is shown with that text (docs/port/24-custom-maps.md, step R4). Measured in build 39167 (time stamp 0x6AE951C4): the pattern is at 0x7C7D10 and the function at 0x7C7CA0.

validate_async_decode_str_func.doc: A build this does not fit shows a map of the server's own with the client's text for name id 0; every other map is unchanged.
